title: First Saturday Open House Raku Firing
commitment: Raku firing 11am-2pm (approximately 1-1.5 hours for firing process)
bring: Pre-made ceramic piece or bring your own bisque-fired piece
summary: Drop-in raku firing during Catalyst's monthly First Saturday Open House. Pick a pre-made piece or bring your own bisque ware, choose glazes, and watch your piece fire in real time with optional horsehair or sawdust reduction.
how_to_join: Show up on First Saturday of the month; no registration mentioned
source_quote:
During October's Open House...
​ Try Raku Pottery Firing from 11am-2pm! For only $10:
Pick the pre-made ceramic piece you want or bring your own bisque-fired piece
evidence_sentence: The First Saturday Open House offers raku firing from 11am-2pm where visitors can fire pieces and apply horsehair or sawdust.
evidence_quote:
Try Raku Pottery Firing from 11am-2pm! For only $10:
Pick the pre-made ceramic piece you want or bring your own bisque-fired piece
Pick your glazes
Watch us fire your piece in real time
Apply horsehair or sawdust yourself to create unpredictable, organic patterns and colors on your pottery
